en: Colorized vintage view showing a riverside embankment with a row of historic multi‑storey buildings in front, labeled shops at street level, and a tree‑lined promenade along a stone river wall. Behind the houses rises a steep, wooded hill with fortification walls and buildings on top, and a funicular or incline railway (Schlossbergbahn) running straight up the slope to the hilltop fortress. The caption at the top is in German.
